title: 5 Mistakes People Make When Seeking God’s Will
paragraphs: 5 Mistakes People Make When Seeking God’s Will

You prayed. You fasted. You waited.
And still… silence.
So you wonder—“Am I missing God’s will?”
Let me speak to you straight, kapatid. Not softly—truthfully.
Here are 5 mistakes people make when seeking God’s will:

1. Treating God’s will like a hidden code to crack
As if He’s playing hide-and-seek with your future.

But Scripture doesn’t paint God as confusing—it reveals Him as a Father.
In James 1:5, He says He gives wisdom generously.

You’re not decoding.
You’re walking with Him.

2. Waiting for a sign while ignoring His Word
You want a voice from heaven…
But you haven’t opened your Bible in days.

God’s will is not a mystery when His Word is closed.
In Psalm 119:105, His Word is the lamp—not your feelings.

You don’t need more signs.
You need more Scripture.

3. Confusing peace with comfort
“Wala akong peace, so maybe it’s not God.”
Careful.

Jesus had no comfort in the garden—
yet it was the Father’s will.

God’s will may stretch you, break pride, expose fear.
Peace is not always the absence of tension.
Sometimes it’s obedience in the middle of it.

4. Asking God to bless what He never approved
You’ve already decided.
Now you just want heaven to co-sign it.

But God doesn’t adjust to your plans—
He invites you into His.

In Proverbs 3:5–6, we don’t lean on our understanding…
we submit.

That’s the word we avoid.
Submit.

5. Thinking God’s will is only about the future
“Lord, what’s next? Where do I go? Who do I become?”
But you’re ignoring what He already said:

Forgive.
Repent.
Love your neighbor.
Live holy.

God’s will is not just direction.
It’s transformation.
But here’s what we miss…

God’s will is not a place you find.
It’s a Person you follow.
And His name is Jesus.

In John 6:38, Jesus said He came not to do His own will—but the Father’s.
And that will led Him… to the cross.
Why?
For you.

For your sin.
For your confusion.
For every wrong turn.
So you don’t have to wander in darkness anymore.
Here’s the truth that sets you free:

If you are in Christ—
seeking Him, surrendering daily—
you are not missing God’s will.
You are walking in it.
And remember—

From confusion to clarity…
from striving to surrender…
because Jesus doesn’t just show the way—
He is the Way.
